> Target: test whether the full proposed core is indispensable across the stated scientific scope, assessing from independent achievements and actual relationships within one unfolding which commitments are necessary and which condition particular descriptions.

<a id="progress--已接通"></a>
## Progress

1. Spine correspondence: discrimination, coupling, testing, generalization, identification and reconstruction results map to independent scientific achievements, separating conditional law, actual correspondence and indispensability. [study](../../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/SCIENTIFIC-INQUIRY-CONDITIONS.md#11-necessity-correspondence-on-the-unified-becoming-spine)
2. Fallible discrimination: an independent coverage/error task requires native responsive relations, a local necessity of structural reach, not a time-ordered causal path by answer time or universal necessity of its mechanism representation. [study](../../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/SCIENTIFIC-INQUIRY-CONDITIONS.md#12-from-fallible-discrimination-to-the-unfoldings-operative-relations)
3. Balance premise tested: common unaccounted exchange suffices for native blindness, a weaker sufficient condition than native balance; task success, descriptive adequacy and premise necessity are kept apart. [study](../../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/SCIENTIFIC-INQUIRY-CONDITIONS.md#13-test-the-premise-what-is-necessary-for-success-and-what-is-necessary-for-a-description)
4. Warranted restrictions: assessed with primary metrological and experimental sources, the restrictions required depend on the task; no formal correspondence from those cases to Flow is claimed. [study](../../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/SCIENTIFIC-INQUIRY-CONDITIONS.md#14-warrant-the-relevant-restrictions-without-requiring-complete-device-knowledge)
5. Stage-relative continuation task: equal completed sequences can omit alternatives kept at the same reached condition, and contextualized histories can be adequate; path, command execution and implementable testing keep separate obligations. [study](../../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/SCIENTIFIC-INQUIRY-CONDITIONS.md#15-which-continuation-relations-does-a-scientific-task-require)
6. Timely response: pre-deadline exchange order joins the fallible bound under common all-initial-state and prefix-mechanism conditions; timely routes are not sufficient control, and no physical duration or causal identification is supplied. [study](../../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/SCIENTIFIC-INQUIRY-CONDITIONS.md#16-a-distinction-must-arrive-before-the-answer-that-uses-it)
7. Scientific standing: completed causal-access bounds inform an assessment separating truth, evidential strength and operative correction; science is not defined by accepting this theory, and representing all outcomes is not confirmation. [study](../../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/SCIENTIFIC-INQUIRY-CONDITIONS.md#17-stronger-foundations-and-the-assessment-of-scientific-standing)
8. Formal side of the demarcation comparison: every reading is what a finite record can refute met with a remainder none can, and a practice keeping a favoured verdict, never refuted by the record, exists exactly where no finite record refutes the verdict; the form alone does not decide standing. [study](../../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/mirror/BECOMING-RENEWAL-READING/205.md#205-what-a-finite-stretch-verifies-and-what-none-can-refute-o1)

<a id="conditions--条件"></a>
## Conditions

- The hypothesis under test, revisable: the complete theory is a necessary foundation of scientific inquiry; the outcome may be the complete core, a part of it, or a commitment that needs revision.

**Not required by this target:**

- No positive verdict is predetermined: full necessity, partial necessity and revision are admissible outcomes, and proof of the strongest hypothesis is no set endpoint.
- No unique vocabulary is required, and no ethical gap substitutes for the scientific gap.
- Task-relevant restrictions need actual warrant, without first exhausting the device.
- Full-theory necessity is not a premise of any proof in this record.

<a id="does-not-show--未表明"></a>
## Does not show

- The source comparison neither removes conditions nor guarantees exclusion of every unknown defect, and is not empirical validation of this model.
- Source correspondence is not a formal experiment-to-Choosing instance; the necessity concerns continuation content for the declared task, not branching-graph syntax.
- Complete endpoint histories are not finite samples, and semantic tests are not physical test procedures.
- No necessary-and-sufficient universal demarcation criterion for science is given.
- No impossibility of the universal target is proved.
- The local results and the ethical route keep their own scopes; this record does not widen them.
- **Counterexample:** Finite natural weights, complete readouts, a common rule and actual probability correspondence are explicit; no calibration of actual laws or science-wide necessity of the whole core is proved. [source](../../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/SCIENTIFIC-INQUIRY-CONDITIONS.md)
- **Counterexample:** The core’s Choosing.sameTests and Choosing.not_alike show that equal move courses do not fix relational structure with general branching; the example has an empty claim type and does not assert equality of frequencies or arbitrary observations. [source](../../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/SCIENTIFIC-INQUIRY-CONDITIONS.md)

**Standard boundaries:** A conditional law does not make its antecedent universal; a theorem's premise is not thereby necessary for every achievement. · A relation omitted by a weaker description does not refute the fuller account. · A law of the formal model; its correspondence to actual systems is a separate obligation.

<a id="evidence--证据"></a>
## Evidence

Correspondence arguments and author counterreview; scoped readings of three primary sources each for restrictions, continuation and scientific standing, with access limits, and nine conceptual counterchecks. Formal results are reused from finite-fallible-inquiry-necessity and timely-response-necessity, whose receipts are in those records; the concrete balance-premise test and the proof of a weaker sufficient condition are among them. No experiment, cross-domain classifier validation or independent review; an earlier proposed test remains unrun.

<a id="correspondence--对应"></a>
### Correspondence

Map independent scientific achievements to the shared spine’s discrimination, coupling, testing, generalization, identification and structural-reconstruction results; distinguish conditional law, actual correspondence and full-core indispensability. Different representations can preserve a relation; the complete test family is not a finite experimental record. Structural necessity uses the complete specified test family, move/claim correspondence and branching conditions; identification uses its stated state bounds and other conditions. Existence of a path, actual command execution and implementable testing have separate correspondence obligations; one experiment does not supply the full modal scope. The assessment of scientific standing is interpretation, not a new formal deduction. Ren directed that this be pursued as a revisable hypothesis (“请按这个方向不断推进”, in the referenced source).
